resources.string: Merge a Saku database file into what is here

Reads a database file made for Saku and adds what this phone does not have yet. Your own data is not replaced, nothing is deleted or changed, and the transactions arrive as one entry in Import history, so they can be reversed.
Everything in this file is already here.
To undo the transactions, reverse this import in Import history. Accounts and categories it created stay and can be archived.
%1$s could not be read as a database.
This database was made for a different version of Saku (version %2$d; this Saku reads version %3$d), so %1$s was not imported.
%1$s does not match Saku\'s database layout. It was built from a different schema.

%1$s lists \"%3$s\" twice in its %2$s table, so Saku cannot tell which one the transactions mean.
%1$s has a transaction (row %2$d) whose category is of the wrong kind for its type.
